# CLAP headers (vendored, unchanged)

[CLAP](https://github.com/free-audio/clap), release 1.2.2, the C headers of the CLever Audio Plug-in API
(`include/clap/`). Licence: MIT (`LICENSE`), GPL-compatible. Used by `src/audioplug/ClapHost.*` (the CLAP
host for audio effects, spec 159) and the test plugin in `tests/audioplug/`.
